title: Region data
sub: Dryness for the 33 districts, the Dukan and Darbandikhan dams, fires seen from space and earlier years. This is what the public View page shows.
how: These numbers are not fixed. They arrive by themselves from the data jobs (see Data jobs). When one is wrong or missing, an admin can correct it by hand with a reason: it is then marked "Edited by hand" and stays until the next job run replaces it. "Let the job replace it" removes the mark straight away.
map_title: Dryness by district (click to zoom in)
pick_hint: Click a district on the map to see its numbers and sub-districts.
edit_sub: Use this when the job's number is wrong or missing. Your name and reason are saved as the source. The next job run replaces the number.
reason_ph: For example: the dam office gave today's level by phone
v_range: A number is outside the possible range.
undo_hint: Removes the Edited by hand mark. The number stays until the next job run.
undone: The next job run will replace it
k_open_n: mark each one after a look
k_near_n: within 1 km of a registered farm
fires_how: Fires come from NASA FIRMS satellites (VIIRS and MODIS) every 3 hours. Many are stubble burning, not wildfires. Mark a fire as checked after you looked at it; fires near registered farms come first.
compare_title: Dryness per district, the biggest change first
compare_note: Same month each year. Higher is drier.
